status: Result record and vector materialization admission integrated; full acceptance remains open
implementation: Row and run backends admit result directories, copied row records and properties before allocation. New window aliases reserve their slots; overwriting a field reuses the existing slot.
All three backends use the safe record setter for aliases, including __proto__ as an own data property.

The vector backend uses the shared physical-shape materialization planner for each selected batch instead of untracked per-row materialization. This admits nested output and packed scalar conversion and preserves selected-row order.

Result reservations use the existing result scope, rolling back failed construction and surviving streaming suspension and asynchronous checkpoint consumption. Input lifetimes continue to pin borrowed payload aliases.
testsAdded: Exact result-directory/record/property cap and one byte below for row/run backends
Special alias stored without changing the output prototype
Selected nested vector materialization at the measured exact peak and one byte below; retained result scope and complete release
remainingAcceptance: Window aggregate result payloads, sort-group planning metadata, final collectors and checkpoint serialization/parsing remain incomplete.
Materialization planning metadata and retained per-batch directories can still be simplified; no claim of optimal reservation size is made.
Delegated task output, post-write cancellation and the complete mixed-job/adaptive scheduling matrix remain open.
Local HTTP/workerd tests are not production Cloudflare enforcement; allocation reservations do not establish a total runtime RAM bound.

worker.scope: Full local workerd suite, including Parquet window routes with shared 64/128 MiB pools
